text:
rachel_cs: Quick health check on Aquilite — onboarding metrics look OK but 95p latency is drifting up (~2.1s) and token cost is ~1.6x expected. renewal flag unclear. thinking we should propose a proactive perf plan (quant + routing + small model swap) to avoid churn. any objections?

david_se: +1 to proactive. can we do an int8 pilot for their inference-heavy /summarize route? should save ~30-40% cost. need to confirm quality delta on their prompts.

maya_ml: I pulled a quick eval on their sample prompts (n=120). int8 (redwood-int8-v2) shows tiny fuzz on few long-context outputs, but ROUGE/approx-match unchanged for 95% of examples. recommend canary with A/B and a rollback gate based on semantic-similarity checks.

kevin_sre: FYI their tenant currently on shared-hosted in us-west. Routing to dedicated or a low-latency reserved pool could lower 95p too, but cost goes up. hybrid route idea: prefer int8 on hosted, failover to fp16 dedicated on high-latency packets.

rachel_cs: good call. customer priority: latency (UX) first, then cost. they mentioned renewal Q3, so we should propose plan and quick enablement.

david_se: propose plan: 1) run 5% traffic canary to int8 for /summarize and /chat-system, 2) measure latency, token-cost, semantic-match for 48 hours, 3) if semantic-match >= 0.98 and latency improvement > 10% accept and ramp. rollback if drift > 2% mismatch. will draft configs.

maya_ml: adding metrics and thresholds: semantic_match (embedding cosine) >= 0.98, avg_95p_latency decrease >= 10% OR absolute 95p < 1.6s, token_cost_reduction >= 20%. also run quick eval on edge cases flagged in onboarding tickets.

rachel_cs: can you drop the canary config? i'll share with the customer and schedule an enablement session.

olga_pm: also capture success story for renewals if this reduces cost without hurting quality. add short feedback survey post-canary.


# canary routing snippet (david_se):

```
route: "aquilite-summarize"
policy:
  - condition: header.path == "/summarize" and rand() < 0.05
    target: redwood-int8-v2
  - condition: header.path == "/summarize"
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
fallback:
  - on_latency_gt: 2500ms
    target: redwood-fp16-stable
```

kevin_sre: ops note — add alerting hooks for semantic_match < 0.98 for 30m and 95p latency > 2s for 15m. I'll create a temporary k8s probe on canary instances to track kv-cache hit ratio.

rachel_cs: tentative timeline: start canary Tue 09:00 PT, monitor 48h, quick sync Wed EOD, ramp Thu morning if green. i'll set up a 30min enablement session for their engs Wed 11:00 PT.

david_se: checklist for enablement session: - explain int8 quality tradeoffs - how routing fallback works - sample prompt set for regressions - how to read console dashboards (latency/cost/semantic)

maya_ml: i'll prepare a short eval notebook and an automated comparator that runs their seed prompts and outputs diff examples and cosine scores. sending link after this thread.

rachel_cs: customer comms draft (short): "We propose a low-risk pilot to reduce inference cost and improve latency by shifting a small portion of your /summarize traffic to an int8 variant. We'll monitor quality and latency in realtime and can revert instantly. Can we run a 48h pilot next Tue?"

olga_pm: love it. add a 1-question NPS-like pulse: "Did summary quality match expectations? (yes / mostly / no)" to collect qualitative feedback.

kevin_sre: I'll provision the canary route and temporary dashboard. tagging ops-bot to schedule alerts.

ops-bot: alert created: channel=#cs-aquilite-alerts, semantic_match < 0.98 (30m), 95p_latency > 2000ms (15m). owner: kevin_sre.

rachel_cs: perfect. i'll message the account and loop in their eng leads. thanks team — will post a reminder tomorrow with owners and calendar invites. :thumbsup:
